description: Réseaux interurbains dans le Puy de Dôme (GTFS STOP) - Ville de Clermont-Ferrand is a dataset listed in opendata.clermontmetropole.eu open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Ce jeu de donnée rassemble les données stop (stations): Réseau interurbain Cars Région Express (producteur La région Auvergne Rhône Alpes) Réseau interurbain du Puy-de-Dôme (producteur La région Auvergne Rhône Alpes) Ce jeu de données est associé au jeu de données: Réseaux interurbains dans le Puy de Dôme (GTFS ROUTE)- Ville de Clermont-Ferrand. Coverage: Clermont Auvergne Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilités - Transports. Its keywords are gtfs, autocars, transport, arret, ligne, urbain. The portal shows 946 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (https://www.opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-clermontmetropole-eu-portal.
